DNuclearKernel.source_compression_kernel.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace X] [Countable ι]
  (nu : Measure X) [SigmaFinite nu] (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (hbm : Measurable b)
  (S : Submodule ℂ ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) [S.HasOrthogonalProjection] (A : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (hz : ((1 - S.starProjection).comp A).comp S.starProjection = 0) (u v : ι → ↥Sᗮ)
  (hc : Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖v i‖)
  (hB : ∀ (y : ↥Sᗮ), HasSum (fun i => ⟪u i, y⟫_ℂ • v i) ((Sᗮ.orthogonalProjection.comp (A.comp Sᗮ.subtypeL)) y)) :
  have k := DNuclearKernel.kernel nu b (fun i => ↑(u i)) fun i => ↑(v i);
  have PA := Sᗮ.starProjection.comp A;
  AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p => k p.1 p.2) (nu.prod nu) ∧
    (∀ (F : ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
        (∀ᵐ (x : X) ∂nu, Integrable (fun y => k x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y))) nu) ∧
          ↑↑(PA F) =ᶠ[ae nu] fun x => ↑(b x) * ∫ (y : X), k x y * (↑↑F y / ↑(b y)) ∂nu) ∧
      Integrable (fun x => k x x) nu ∧ ∫ (x : X), k x x ∂nu = Masullo.TraceClass.trace PA
